text: Nde ɓe udditunoo doŋlle maɓɓe ñaametee ɗen ɗe ɓe addori, ɓe tawi coggeeli mun ɗin ruttitaama e maɓɓe. Ɓe wi'ani ben maɓɓe: E ko men ɗaɓɓata ɓuri ngal teddungal ɗoo? Ɗum ɗoo ko coggu ñaametee amen on, laamɗo on jonnitirii men ɗum teddingol men. Men addanay yimɓe amen ɓen ñaametee, men reena musiɗɗo amen on e ko hulan-ɗaa mo kon, men ɓeydora ɓetu ngelooba tawde mba ronndannto men; ɓeydorgol ɓetu ngelooba, ko huunde newiinde ka laamɗo on.
